title: Imbewu Encazana
description: Esigodini esisemkhuphukeleni weNtaba ye-Kenya, kwakunomntazanyana owabe asebenza nonina emasimini. Watshwenyeka nakabona imithi emikhulu itjhabalala, kodwana bekawazi amandla wembewu encazana.
subjects: Nature and looking after our planet
